name: B2B Portal Authentication (Username + Password)
journey_path: Existing Business Customer Registering & Logging-on to B2B Portal
summary: Enter the Username and password shared during registration. Click Sign In. If a default organization exists, the Dashboard appears; otherwise, the Select Organization screen is shown. Then click an organization to view its Dashboard.

steps.action: Navigate to the B2B Portal login page
steps.expected_result: The login page loads with the SIGN IN TO BUSINESS ONLINE panel

steps.action: Select the 'e& Password' tab of the credentials panel
steps.expected_result: 'e& Password' is selected and shows Username or email*, Password*, Remember me, FORGOT PASSWORD? and SIGN IN

steps.action: Enter the Username shared during registration in 'Username or email*'
Enter the password shared during registration in 'Password*'

steps.expected_result: The credentials are verified and the portal leaves the login page
Either 'Select a Organization to continue' (no default organization) or the Organization Dashboard (default organization) is displayed

open_questions: What happens if the username or password is incorrect? The document does not specify error handling.

extraction.note: Extracted from a design document and reviewed before publishing; no locators. Selectors come from the journey-guided crawl.
